decision.rationale: The dispute is within the time limit. TXN-008004 posted on 2026-10-14 and the dispute was opened on 2026-10-25, which is 11 days later. The limit is 120 days. The card has two postings of 94.76 EUR at HARBOUR MARKET (MER-000064). TXN-008004 was made at 2026-10-13T04:16:14Z, posted 2026-10-14 and authorised under AUTH-008203. TXN-008003 was made at 2026-10-12T20:16:14Z, posted 2026-10-13 and authorised under AUTH-008202. The two postings do not share an authorisation. Each authorisation was approved separately with no fraud flag. AUTH-008202 was a chip payment with the PIN verified. AUTH-008203 was a contactless payment made about 8 hours later. The ledger shows no refund at this merchant. Under the policy, two postings with their own authorisations made some time apart count as two purchases, even when the merchant and the amount are the same, so the dispute is declined.

proposed_actions.reason: The two 94.76 EUR charges from HARBOUR MARKET were approved as two separate payments about 8 hours apart: a chip payment with your PIN on 12 October 2026 and a contactless payment on 13 October 2026. They are two separate purchases, not one purchase charged twice, so the dispute cannot be upheld as a duplicate charge.
